releaseNotes: • Improvement: Continuous +10s Progressive Skip Loop — movie & streaming players (Nuvio, Stremio, CloudStream, VLC, YouTube, fullscreen browser videos) never back-exit after 2 skips in Smart Mode; instead SaveGaze blurs, skips +10s/+15s forward cleanly, resets stale frame caches, re-checks the new frame, and keeps skipping +10s step-by-step until normal content returns.
